question: Does placing each incomplete KPool tail immediately after that row's valid complete-pool history improve the four-window P8 forced-decode KLD?

v1_intervention_integrity_failure.cause: v1 placed the tail at topk-tail_count instead of after the row's valid history

single_variable_change.baseline: Emit expanded selected complete pools in columns 0:2048 and append the incomplete tail in columns 2048:2051, which the consumer does not read.
single_variable_change.candidate: When all complete pools fit, emit exactly floor(L/4)*4 valid history tokens, then L mod 4 causal tail tokens, then -1 padding. If more than 512 complete pools exist, retain v1's explicit lowest-priority displacement rule.
unchanged: compressed-pool scorer and fixed logical-short-v1 pool ordering
K4 procedural-MCG P8 codec bytes, native fused MoE path, and exact 4.25 payload bpw
B12X sparse attention after selected-index construction, TP4/no-EP/DCP1, NVFP4 MLA KV, CUDA graphs, and MTP off
four opened windows, forced-token capture, teachers, CPU KLD, storage boundary, and decision thresholds

mandatory_intervention_integrity_gate.pass: candidate differs bitwise from the pinned baseline exactly when L mod 4 is in 1..3; it is bit-identical when L mod 4 is 0; each changed row preserves all complete-pool tokens, appends exactly its causal tail, then only -1 padding
mandatory_intervention_integrity_gate.failure: Do not run KLD; repair implementation and predeclare another version.
mandatory_intervention_integrity_gate.final_logit_note: Autoregressive KV carry can propagate an earlier changed row into later L mod 4 = 0 logits, so downstream final-logit row selectivity is reported but is not the selector-integrity gate.

decision_before_result.material_tail_cause_supported: Candidate mean is at least 20 percent lower than baseline and at least three windows improve.
decision_before_result.material_tail_cause_rejected: Candidate relative improvement is at most 5 percent after the intervention-integrity gate passes.
decision_before_result.otherwise: Directional but inconclusive; preserve the point estimate without rerolling.

retry_policy: One sealed execution after device closure; no silent retry, window substitution, threshold change, or reuse of the invalid v1 candidate.
claim_boundary: Targeted serving-path causal diagnostic, not full32 product qualification.
